note: Sealed source bindings for the N512 analytical reference observer: the two verbatim #[path]-included sources and the complete source inventories of both path-dependency crates. The included sources and this inventory are embedded into the binary with include_bytes!, so every published observer output carries the SHA-256 of the exact compiled decoder/model bytes, this inventory's own digest, both crates' full per-file inventories and each crate's aggregate digest (SHA-256 over the sorted 'repository_path  sha256\n' lines, recomputed from the compiled inventory and cross-checked against the sealed aggregate). The inventory test re-hashes every listed file against these digests.
